title: The region 0 ≤ y ≤ x ≤ 1
caption: The triangle with corners (0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 1) has area ½. For each x from 0 to 1, y runs from 0 up to x, so ∬ xy dA = ∫₀¹ x · (x²/2) dx = 1/8.
alt: A right triangle under the line y = x between x = 0 and x = 1, with a vertical strip at fixed x running from y = 0 up to y = x.
description: The region is bounded by y = 0, x = 1 and the line y = x.
At a fixed x the strip runs from y = 0 to y = x.
Integrate over y first: ∫₀ˣ xy dy = x³/2; then over x: ∫₀¹ x³/2 dx = 1/8.
